name: content_in_default_fallback
description: No PR recorded and the forge knows no PR, so the merged-PR path cannot fire. The branch adds feature.txt and the same net change landed independently on origin/main as a squash commit. The primary clone has NOT fetched since, so its origin/main is stale: the guard must fetch the default branch before the content check. Allowed via content-in-default (the reference also asserts the destructive cleanup step was reached).
